description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity of an Android app, hosting a TV content big-screen interface with navigation buttons and search functionality. It manages fragment transactions to display different content sections like Home, EPG, Favorites, and Search.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing navigation and search in the TV big-screen app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, click listeners, and default fragment.

methods.name: showEpg
methods.description: Displays the EPG (Electronic Program Guide) fragment.

methods.name: showSearch
methods.description: Displays the Search fragment with the given query.
